prompt: Before I propose a plan, I want to settle on the right starting point. A few quick choices:

questions.prompt: What is the single first concrete goal you want to tackle?

options.label: Build the WhatsApp to endpoints bridge (MVP)
options.description: Stand up a working WhatsApp client that forwards prompts to Qwen Code, Perplexity RP/DR, and Firecrawl across 4 groups, with image/video saving and Whisper transcription. Voice answer (ElevenLabs), Paperclip integration, and Grill-me come later.

options.label: Produce a detailed build blueprint first
options.description: Write the full architecture, group routing logic, message-handling pipeline, media pipeline, and feature specs as a design doc — no code yet — so we know exactly what we will build before we build it.

options.label: Quick throwaway prototype of the dispatcher
options.description: A small, scrappy dispatcher that pretends to be the four endpoints, proving the WhatsApp-to-model routing shape before we commit to real provider integrations.

questions.prompt: How ready are the third-party API credentials (Qwen, Perplexity, Firecrawl, OpenAI Whisper, ElevenLabs, WhatsApp Business API)?

options.label: I have them all ready to plug in
options.description: We can integrate against the live endpoints right away.

options.label: I have some, mock the rest
options.description: Use real keys where available, stub the others so development is not blocked.

options.label: I do not have any yet
options.description: Build everything against mocks/stubs; I will wire real keys later.

questions.prompt: What is the stack/language preference for the WhatsApp client itself?

options.label: Node.js + TypeScript
options.description: Mature whatsapp-web.js ecosystem, fast to iterate.

options.label: You pick the best fit
options.description: I propose the stack as part of the plan based on ecosystem fit.

questions.prompt: What does done look like for the first deliverable so I know when to stop?

options.label: I can send a text prompt in each of the 4 groups and get a real model reply back
options.description: Happiest-path only; media + voice + special features are not in scope yet.

options.label: Every feature in the mission works end-to-end (media, voice, Grill-me, Paperclip, ElevenLabs)
options.description: Full feature parity from day one.

options.label: A demoable run I can show to a stakeholder
options.description: Stable enough to show off, even if a few features are stubbed.
